title: Customer Service Representative - Relocation Required
description:
Vantage is a global, multi-regulated, multi-asset broker based in Sydney, offering clients access to trading CFDs on Forex, Commodities, Indices, Shares, and Cryptocurrencies. With over 10 years of market experience, Vantage has a strong presence with more than 1,000 employees across 30 global offices. Vantage provides a trusted trading ecosystem and a user-friendly platform for clients to capitalize on trading opportunities.


OPEN ONLY to individuals willing to relocate.


This is a unique opportunity for Customer Service Rockstars interested in living and developing a career in Southeast Asia: Malaysia or Thailand . The company will provide all necessary visa assistance and relocation support. During the visa processing, work remotely from your base country.


Responsibilities:

  • Provide frontline support to our customers via live chat, phone, and email.
  • Answering queries and resolving client issues regarding our products, platforms, and promotions.
  • Address customer feedback and complaints professionally.
  • Record and update customer data and other relevant information when necessary.
  • Supporting documentation/administrative needs within the department and supporting translation for customer announcement notices.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree, fresh graduates welcome to apply.
  • Over 2 years of experience in Customer Service, highly preferred in crypto or fintech, but any industry is welcome.
  • Mandatory rotation shift schedule with night shifts once relocated.
  • Experience in international settings and teams.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese is MANDATORY
  • Exceptional communication skills with a superb client focus.
  • Logical and analytical approach to problem-solving.
  • Knowledge or interest in trading is highly desirable, but not essential.


We offer :

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Remote work while relocation is processed
  • Local benefits according to the chosen relocation country
  • Relocation support, including visa sponsorship and additional expenses
  • Career development in a fast-paced industry

title: Especialista ServiceNow (inglês fluente)
description:
#OPORTUNIDADE para Consultor/Especialista ServiceNow


Vaga: Senior ServiceNow Administrator / Developer / Integrator

Remoto | Contractor via Deel | Fuso horário: EST

Projeto de 3 a 6 meses (possibilidade de extensão)

Inglês fluente obrigatório | Espanhol é diferencial


A Stefanini LATAM está apoiando um grande grupo do setor de manufatura e mineração que está passando por uma migração e reorganização significativa da plataforma ServiceNow. Estamos buscando um Especialista ServiceNow realmente sênior, capaz de trabalhar de forma autônoma, com produtividade imediata e forte domínio técnico.


Esta pessoa deverá atuar diretamente na melhoria, integração e reestruturação dos serviços ServiceNow, acessos, workflows, automações e APIs — especialmente em um ambiente que está sendo reorganizado por um provedor global, demandando best practices, correções estruturais e integração de sistemas legados.


Responsabilidades:


  • Administrar, configurar e otimizar o ServiceNow em nível avançado (ITSM, acessos, workflows, políticas, automação).
  • Evoluir e manter o Service Operations Workspace.
  • Desenvolver e integrar APIs de terceiros, incluindo plataformas como AWS e ferramentas corporativas.
  • Atuar com automações, Virtual Agent / Chat Agents e recursos de IA no ServiceNow (diferencial).
  • Implementar melhorias estruturais identificadas pelo provedor Oxys.
  • Corrigir configurações existentes e aplicar best practices recomendadas para governança ServiceNow.
  • Trabalhar de forma independente, recebendo demandas e entregando soluções com mínima supervisão.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
A Exadel está procurando um Desenvolvedor Fullstack de Nível Intermediário (Java + Angular+ Quarkus) . Este profissional contribuirá tanto nas tarefas de desenvolvimento back-end quanto front-end, enquanto também desempenha um papel na garantia da qualidade do produto por meio de testes e validação. O foco será na entrega de recursos robustos, validação de integrações FIX, construção de interfaces de usuário e suporte a testes automatizados, tudo em estreita colaboração com a equipe sênior.


Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e manter aplicações usando Java + Quarkus no back-end e Angular no front-end. Entregar funcionalidades, correções de bugs e melhorias na interface com atenção ao desempenho e à usabilidade. Criar, executar e manter testes automatizados (unitários, de integração, ponta a ponta). Garantir a qualidade do código e contribuir para manter uma alta cobertura de testes em toda a pilha. Colaborar em atividades de QA, validando tanto requisitos técnicos quanto de negócios. Fornecer suporte na resolução de problemas de aplicações em produção de baixa/média complexidade. Trabalhar em um ambiente ágil e colaborativo, interagindo com equipes de negócios, produtos e tecnologia.


Experiência prática com Java 11+ e Quarkus (RESTEasy, Panache, MicroProfile). Conhecimento sólido de Angular para desenvolvimento front-end. Experiência básica a intermediária com o protocolo FIX. Experiência com JUnit, RestAssured ou outros frameworks de automação de testes. Compreensão de APIs REST e desenvolvimento de aplicações web. Conhecimento de SQL e bancos de dados relacionais. Familiaridade com Git e pipelines de CI/CD.

title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
description:
We are Software Mind, an awesome team of engineers who are ready to ramp up any top-notch company’s projects! Our aim? To always be one step ahead. Become part of a multicultural company in constant growth with an excellent work environment certified by Great Place To Work!


Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Principal Software Engineer to join one of our USA Clients' engineering teams which is building solutions to dramatically change the way people purchase their daily goods, providing the modern-day solution to meet customer’s immediate everyday needs with products ranging from snacks and ice cream to household goods and beer, at the click of a button. If you enjoy working with cutting-edge technologies in a fast-paced environment this opportunity is for you!

Expectations - the experience you need

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science (or related field)
  • 8+ years of experience in a senior engineering role with increasing responsibility, focused on Backend Development & Integrations.
  • Experience acting in a tech lead capacity for a small team without direction.
  • Proficiency with SQL, Postgres, NodeJS, Java, and/or Go.
  • Solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and their application in building.
  • Data intensive applications that process high velocity data (millions of transactions) or high-volume data (transactions impacting millions of records).
  • Experience using Terraform, Pulumi, Helm, GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with SQL data analysis (Snowflake/BigQuery), some familiarity of data pipelines.
  • Experience with message-based, async processing.
  • Experience with JavaScript & SPA technology in a production setting (e.g. Vue, React).
  • Public cloud experience in a production setting (Azure preferred).
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Responsibilities - What you'll do

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality software solutions.
  • Implement system and data monitors to ensure the correctness of the business process.
  • Contribute to multiple team-wide business and tech objectives (beyond just the goals assigned).
  • Lead cross-functional projects in an agile environment; participate in planning, Scope, decompose, and organize projects for multiple teammates.
  • Delegate tasks and coordinate teammates to bring those projects to completion with minimal oversight.
  • Generate time estimates with reasonable accuracy to help determine project timelines.
  • Support standard development practices across your team, including idiomatic syntax, design patterns, and Testing/Quality Practice.
  • Provide primary operational support and engineering for multiple large distributed software applications.
  • Integrate with existing REST APIs, author new APIs, and expose the data to the frontend.

Our offer – professional development, personal growth

  • Educational resources
  • Flexible schedule and work from anywhere
  • Referral Program
  • Supportive and chill atmosphere

We are accepting applications from LATAM countries

#LI-DNI

title: Profissional Backend Java - Sênior
description:
Sobre a vaga


Código da vaga: 56197


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Experiência com Java para Backend e experiência com o framework Spring.
  • Vivência com serviços AWS.
  • Experiência prática em Clean Code e Arquitetura Hexagonal.
  • Habilidade para escrever e aplicar diversos tipos de Testes (Unitários, Integração, etc.).
  • Experiência com GitHub.
  • Familiaridade com CI/CD
  • Experiência com Terraform
  • Uso de ferramentas de monitoramento/observabilidade, como Datadog.


Modelo de atuação


  • 100% remoto



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Save Lives, Get Paid: Mid-level SQL Dev
description:

Want a chance to (100% remote) work at a financially stable California company, learn from seasoned tech leads that work with pharmaceutical companies to get life saving drugs into patient populations?

Own complex data querying and enable fast, clean data exports for BI tools.


Key Requirements:

  • Expert-level SQL , capable of writing complex, performant queries.
  • Experience with Sigma  (similar to Tableau ).
  • English : Comfortable collaborating directly with stakeholders and producing analysis-ready datasets.


Interview Process:

  • No leet code, just real world exercises with tech leads who will treat you with the respect you deserve. We pay well, because we hire the best. Is this you?


Video question:

"Let’s say a dashboard shows yesterday’s revenue as $1.2M , but the finance team reports $1.0M . How would you go about figuring out which number is right?"


Submit your video here: 


*Applications that submitted a 60-second video answering the question will be given the highest priority . Only our most Senior HR Manager will watch your video and delete it afterward. We review 100% of the videos submitted.


Please do not apply if you do not meet our requirements, as we won’t be able to respond.

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Senior Financial Analyst


Role Summary

The FP&A Finance team is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to support FP&A and month-end close activities across the Products FP&A team . This role requires a high degree of accuracy, attention to detail, and accountability to deadlines. Reporting to the Manager of Products FP&A , the analyst will be a key contributor across the broader FP&A organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and headcount analysis
  • Perform headcount reconciliation and reporting
  • Manage department expenses, including PO approval and tracking
  • Build and maintain financial models (Excel: intermediate to advanced)
  • Populate dashboards and KPI tools for data-driven decision-making
  • Monitor KPIs and analyze performance trends and drivers
  • Participate in monthly and quarterly close; prepare entries and reconciliations
  • Support global forecasting and budgeting for headcount and operational expenses
  • Conduct monthly variance analysis to ensure expenses are planned and justified
  • Prepare financial reporting for business partners (monthly, quarterly, ad hoc)
  • Perform margin analysis and automate manual reports in Excel and Hyperion
  • Provide general support for ad hoc projects and reporting requests
  • Collaborate closely with Product Management and Engineering teams
  • Operate independently in a remote-first environment with proactive communication

Qualifications

Education : Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or Finance (MBA preferred but not required)

  • Experience : 4–7+ years in FP&A, financial analysis, P&L modeling, and monthly close
  • Strong preference for experience supporting R&D, Engineering, or Product teams
  • Experience in multi-national, dynamic business environments
  • Technical Skills :
  • Advanced Excel modeling and automation
  • ERP systems (Oracle required), Hyperion reporting
  • Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint; Excel: intermediate to advanced)
  • Soft Skills :
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Detail-oriented with excellent time management and prioritization
  • Clear communicator with ability to present data simply and effectively
  • Team-oriented, self-starter, and comfortable working cross-functionally
  • Able to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Maintains confidentiality with sensitive financial data

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior "#983964"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente no segmento da área de Tecnologia.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados usando Spark, PySpark ou Scala no Databricks, garantindo automação e performance em processos ETL de grande volume;
  • Modelar, integrar e transformar dados complexos utilizando SQL avançado, assegurando qualidade e disponibilidade para áreas de negócio e analytics;
  • Criar e otimizar jobs em Spark para ingestão, limpeza, padronização e enriquecimento de dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes;
  • Monitorar, documentar e otimizar a infraestrutura de dados, garantindo governança, escalabilidade, segurança e alto desempenho em ambientes de nuvem e plataformas como Databricks.

O que você precisa ter

  • Conhecimento de SQL e experiência com Databricks;
  • Familiaridade com Power BI e Tableau;
  • Proficiência em SQL e experiência prática com Databricks, Spark e Scala;
  • Experiência na criação de dashboards com Power BI;
  • Familiaridade com integração de jobs Spark para processos ETL;
  • Habilidades avançadas em SQL para manipulação e integração complexa de dados;
  • Expertise em Databricks, Spark, Scala e PySpark para engenharia de dados em larga escala;
  • Experiência em Azure;
  • Experiência em mensageria (Kafka, Service Bus).


Qualificações

  • Bacharelado em Ciência de Dados, Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada;
  • Experiência em engenharia de dados ou funções relacionadas;
  • Experiência no setor financeiro/adquirência.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

Regime de Contratação

CLT.

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Control M;
  • Experiência prévia em Desenvolvimento Java;
  • Espanhol e Inglês.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Hey, Dev, check the opportunity we have here at Brick Abode!


About Brick Abode


We are a software development company that serves clients from multiple countries around the world, with differing technological needs. Therefore, we value a good computer science base.


Contractors with a solid understanding of the basic building blocks of today’s technology are really welcome and thrive at Brick Abode.


People here are given autonomy, not put into a box to work only on one thing. They are in touch with the business needs of our clients, sometimes communicating with them directly.


We challenge ourselves to learn new things and go outside our comfort zone. Candidates who are up to the challenge will have an amazing career with us.


If you feel that your values fit with Brick Abode culture, check below for further details about this Position.


What kind of professional are we looking for?


We’re looking for a responsible and proactive professional who can navigate between technology and business contexts with ease, feel comfortable in fast-paced environments, and have great communication skills.

Our team is Brazil and USA-based, and communication is in English. The position is fully remote.



What do I need to have to apply for this position?


  • Python (with strong data handling experience): ETL pipelines, familiarity with DataFrames (Pandas or similar)
  • PostgreSQL (loading, validation, filtering)
  • Familiarity with the AWS Cloud ecosystem
  • CI/CD and code hygiene for data pipelines
  • Machine Learning
  • Fluent English
  • An academic background (MSc or PhD) will also be a plus



As Contractor (PJ), you will have:


  • Competitive compensation (in Reais - R$)
  • Work with international clients with international standards
  • Opportunity to grow as a leader
  • Possibility to move between teams
  • Speak in English with your coworkers
  • 2 weeks of paid leave per year
  • National holidays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid marriage leave
  • Working with a company that cares about our people and their personal growth
  • All expenses paid for training, conferences, and online courses
  • Remote work
  • Health Care Plan - Online


If you are passionate about technology and have a strong desire to work on cutting-edge projects, we encourage you to apply for this position!


Submit your CV to make sure it contains your LinkedIn and GitHub accounts.

Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

title: Manager Operations BPS Brazil
description:
Role Purpose

Drive continuous improvement initiatives across BPS operations to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and improve service quality. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify process gaps and implement best practices.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide timely and meaningful reporting to senior management.
  • Plan and implement strategies to ensure account profitability.
  • Handle client interactions and manage escalations (calls or in-person).
  • Conduct regular reviews with Account Managers and other departments to ensure SLA adherence.
  • Monitor daily productivity against defined service level standards.
  • Perform audit checks on client-defined compliance requirements.
  • Coach and monitor Team Leads and AMs in day-to-day operations and people management.
  • Develop continuous learning processes for the team.
  • Supervise and support team members to ensure delivery meets or exceeds client quality standards.
  • Represent the organization during client visits and reviews.
  • Lead process re-engineering projects to optimize workflows and reduce cycle times.
  • Develop and maintain process documentation, SOPs, and compliance standards.
  • Partner with stakeholders to implement digital tools and automation for operational efficiency.
  • Monitor KPIs and prepare dashboards to track improvement outcomes.
  • Conduct training sessions on process excellence methodologies for team members.


Required/ Preferred Skills & Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of BPS operations and service delivery models.
  • Provide timely and meaningful reporting to senior management.
  • Plan and implement strategies to ensure account profitability.
  • Handle client interactions and manage escalations (calls or in-person).
  • Conduct regular reviews with Account Managers and other departments to ensure SLA adherence.
  • Monitor daily productivity against defined service level standards.
  • Perform audit checks on client-defined compliance requirements.
  • Coach and monitor Team Leads and AMs in day-to-day operations and people management.
  • Develop continuous learning processes for the team.
  • Supervise and support team members to ensure delivery meets or exceeds client quality standards.
  • Represent the organization during client visits and reviews.
  • Proficiency in process mapping tools and data analysis (Excel, Power BI).
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deliver within timelines.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in process improvement within BPS or shared services.
  • Preferred Certification in Lean Six Sigma or equivalent preferred.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Pleno
description:
Código da vaga: 56240


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.



  • Ei, profissional Engenheiro de Dados, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

• Experiência sólida com Google Cloud Platform .

• Domínio em: o BigQuery o Cloud Storage (GCS) o Cloud Run o Vertex AI o Airflow/Cloud Composer

• Vivência prática na criação, versionamento e monitoramento de DAGs.

• Proficiência em Python e conhecimento intermediário/avançado em SQL .

• Conhecimento de arquiteturas Lakehouse.

• Experiência com CI/CD (Cloud Build, GitHub Actions) .

• Experiência com Git e boas práticas de engenharia de dados.


Responsabilidades

• Desenvolver, evoluir e manter DAGs no Apache Airflow / Cloud Composer.

• Construir pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT) escaláveis e de alta performance.

• Criar modelos, tabelas e rotinas de dados no BigQuery.

• Implementar integrações e serviços utilizando Cloud Run ou Cloud Functions.

• Estruturar e gerenciar camadas de dados no Google Cloud Storage.

• Colaborar com times de produto, engenharia e analytics na definição de soluções de dados.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

description:
Conheça abaixo as oportunidades que estão disponíveis no momento:


  • Engenheiro de Dados Pleno (IA)
  • Engenheiro de Dados Pleno (BI)


Qual será sua ocupação?


Engenheiro de Dados Pleno


O que esperamos de você?


Engenheiro de Dados Pleno (IA):

  • Experiência em modelagem, arquitetura e integração de dados (DW, Data Lake, Lakehouse).
  • Domínio de Python e SQL, além de trabalhar bem com frameworks de processamento como Spark, Databricks, Airflow ou equivalentes.
  • Vivência na construção de pipelines escaláveis e de alto desempenho, com práticas modernas de versionamento, testes e CI/CD.
  • Conhecimento aplicado em soluções de Machine Learning/IA, incluindo preparação de dados para modelos, feature store, monitoramento e integração com modelos em produção.
  • Experiência com serviços em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Experiência em SQL Server, incluindo consultas, modelagem de dados e otimização de desempenho.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação de processos, como UiPath, Open RPA, N8N ou similares.

Diferenciais: Participação em projetos de automação IA (Chatgpt, Gemini,Grok, etc).

Capacidade de propor soluções de ponta e trazer visão estratégica para o uso de IA na empresa.


Quais serão os seus desafios?

Estruturar e treinar modelos de IA para automação de tarefas repetitivas.

Garantir integração de IA com sistemas jurídicos.

Sustentação a projetos de inovação e demandas corporativas.

Análise de requisitos e desenvolvimento de soluções técnicas eficientes, atuando diretamente na manutenção de sistemas e aplicações da empresa.

Atuar na análise de necessidades propondo soluções de automações sistêmicas com IA garantindo governança, qualidade, rastreabilidade e disponibilidade dos dados.

Apoiar a evolução da plataforma de dados, definindo boas práticas, padrões e automações.

Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua, propondo soluções escaláveis e eficientes para desafios complexos de dados.

Desenvolver scripts ou manipulação de dados para melhoria sistêmica e/ou segurança dos dados.

Sustentação e manutenção de softwares de ERP e HCM, incluindo customizações e suporte a usuários finais.


Engenheiro de Dados Pleno (BI):

  • Experiência em modelagem, arquitetura e integração de múltiplas fontes (ERP, CRM, APIs, bancos relacionais e não relacionais).
  • Domínio de SQL e boas práticas de performance, particionamento e tuning.
  • Experiência com Python e SQL, além de trabalhar bem com frameworks de processamento como Spark, Databricks, Airflow ou equivalentes.
  • Vivência na construção de pipelines escaláveis e de alto desempenho, com práticas modernas de versionamento, testes e CI/CD.
  • Atuação na criação de estruturas para Data Warehouse, Data Lake ou LakehouseExperiência com serviços em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Expertise em Business Intelligence: modelagem dimensional, fatos/dimensões, métricas, KPIs e governança de relatórios.
  • Experiência com plataformas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker ou similares), garantindo dados consistentes e de qualidade.


Diferenciais: Atuação anterior na definição de arquitetura de BI corporativa ou padronização de métricas/KPIs estratégicas.

Construção de soluções analíticas avançadas, como dashboards preditivos, métricas automatizadas ou integrações com APIs internas e externas.

Experiência com Snowflake ou outros cloud data warehouses;


Quais serão os seus desafios?

Desenvolver integrações entres sistemas jurídicos e plataformas internas.

Preparação de bases para criação de um data lake.

Garantir padronização e confiabilidade de dados.

Apoiar projetos de BI e advanced analytics.

Sustentação a projetos de inovação e demandas corporativas.

suportem dashboards, análises e produtos de dados de alta confiabilidade.

  • API REST, OAuth, JWT.
  • Ferramentas de CI/CD: Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions .
  • Ajustes e comunicação com APIs REST.
  • Testes unitários com Jest .
  • Aplicação dos princípios de Clean Code e SOLID .


Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)

  • Boa comunicação com pares e áreas solicitantes.
  • Trabalho em equipe e colaboração ativa.
  • Comprometimento, pontualidade e responsabilidade.
  • Capacidade de aprendizado rápido e autonomia.
  • Proatividade e foco em resultado.


Metodologias

  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis: Scrum, Kanban e ferramentas como Jira .


Modelo de Trabalho

  • 100% Remoto – trabalhe de qualquer lugar do Brasil!


Benefícios – Clube da Four

  • VR e VA flexível.
  • Gympass e Wellz.
  • Parceria com SESC.

title: Bilingual Account Coordinator
description:
Are you the kind of person who thrives in the center of the action: keeping customers happy, teams aligned, and problems solved before they even arise? We’re looking for an Account Coordinator who’s proactive, detail-obsessed, and fueled by customer satisfaction.


In this role, you’ll be the glue between our clients, field teams, and leadership. Making sure every call, installation, and email ends with a 5-star smile from our client and customer.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own the 5-star customer experience: satisfaction isn’t enough, we go for exceeded expectations
  • Manage calls with customers and technicians, keeping the flow smooth and the tone friendly
  • Schedule, confirm, or reschedule installations like a logistics magician
  • Notify customers of their time windows and make sure everyone’s in the know
  • Send routes and job assignments to technicians for the next day
  • Call techs for ETA updates and relay real-time info to customers
  • Respond to emails and assist incoming calls when needed: stay sharp and helpful
  • Handle escalated situations with confidence, empathy, and a calm voice
  • Maintain communication with clients and business partners to ensure alignment


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years in customer service roles (bonus points for field-service coordination)
  • Advanced English fluency (C1 or C2 level): you’re confident on the phone and in writing
  • Able to juggle tasks like a pro while staying positive and focused
  • Independent and highly responsible: you don’t wait to be told, you do


Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting American clients or companies
  • Proven leadership in previous roles: if you’ve guided teams, we’d love to hear about it


Schedule & Setup

  • Hours: 11 AM – 8 PM (California Time / PST)
  • 1-hour break included
  • Fully remote: work from anywhere, but your setup must support success
  • 1-week PTO after the first year working with us


Tech Requirements

  • A reliable computer with fast internet
  • Headset with clear mic and strong audio
  • A quiet space: no distractions, just action

title: Account Assistant – Social Creators (Júnior)
description:
A WIP é um estúdio de design de narrativa que une storytelling e branding de forma estratégica, fazendo gestão de criadores e conteúdos para gerar impacto cultural através das marcas. Trabalhamos com métodos proprietários e processos ágeis para desenvolver narrativas e projetos que conectam, engajam e geram valor real.


Sobre o cargo


Como Account Assistant – Social Creators (Júnior), você será responsável por dar suporte ao time na operação do dia a dia com criadores de conteúdo.

O foco da vaga é organização, acompanhamento das entregas e apoio na comunicação com criadores e clientes.


É uma vaga para quem está começando no mercado, gosta do universo de conteúdo e quer aprender rápido sobre influência, redes sociais e rotinas de campanhas.


Responsabilidades principais


  • Dar apoio nas primeiras conversas com criadores (envio de informações, coleta de valores e detalhes básicos);
  • Acompanhar criadores após a contratação (repassar briefings, tirar dúvidas simples, organizar prazos e entregas);
  • Garantir atualização das informações em planilhas e sistemas internos;
  • Ajudar no controle de entregas (roteiros, vídeos, posts, stories, prazos e refações);
  • Fazer checklists, atualizar status e apoiar no envio de materiais para aprovadores;
  • Auxiliar na organização de reuniões, pautas e acompanhamentos;
  • Pesquisar tendências de redes sociais e referências simples para apoiar os projetos;
  • Ajudar no mapeamento inicial de criadores, buscando perfis alinhados ao briefing.


Qualidades esperadas


  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para lidar com pessoas;
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes (vai lidar com prazos e muitas informações);
  • Vontade de aprender e crescer no universo de criadores;
  • Perfil proativo, colaborativo e com boa gestão de prioridades;
  • Fluência em espanhol (obrigatório).


Ferramentas utilizadas

﻿

  • Influency.me
  • Social Blade
  • TikTok, Instagram, YouTube e Twitch
  • Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive)
  • Canva
  • Monday
  • Slack

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Somos uma consultoria especializada em TI , apaixonada por desafios e comprometida em impulsionar transformações tecnológicas estratégicas para nossos clientes. Se você busca crescimento profissional e deseja atuar em projetos inovadores, essa oportunidade é para você.


Modelo de contratação: PJ

Modalidade: Home Office


Requisitos

• Experiência prática em Azure DevOps (Repos, Pipelines, Boards, Artifacts).

• Conhecimento em CI/CD, Git, YAML pipelines e automação de builds/deploys.

• Vivência em gestão de acesso e políticas de segurança no Azure.

• Familiaridade com PowerShell, Terraform, ARM Templates ou Bicep para infraestrutura

como código.

• Capacidade de auditar e organizar ambientes legados, propondo melhorias de

governança.

• Boa comunicação e autonomia para interagir com áreas de desenvolvimento, segurança e

infraestrutura.

• Excelente comunicação e capacidade de traduzir linguagem técnica em

impacto de negócio.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Principais Atividades e Desafios:

• Estruturar e implantar a governança completa do Azure DevOps, incluindo políticas,

permissões, pipelines e controles de acesso.

• Implementar proteção do código-fonte (branch policies, code reviews obrigatórios, gestão

de secrets e credenciais).

• Revisar e organizar repositórios existentes, garantindo versionamento adequado e

padronização de nomenclaturas.

• Automatizar pipelines de CI/CD para garantir entregas consistentes e seguras.

• Integrar processos de DevOps com Azure, GitHub, Power BI, SonarQube ou ferramentas

de monitoramento.

• Apoiar squads e desenvolvedores na adoção de boas práticas de versionamento, build e

release.

• Monitorar e manter segurança, compliance e performance do ambiente de DevOps.


Diferenciais:

• Certificação Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert.

• Experiência em integração DevSecOps.

• Conhecimento em políticas de proteção de código e auditoria em ambientes regulados.

• Vivência em automação de governança (Policy as Code, GitHub Advanced Security, etc.).


Se identificou com a oportunidade? Envie seu CV e venha fazer parte do nosso time.

title: ANALISTA DE OPERAÇÕES MARÍTIMAS - IMPORTAÇÃO & EXPORTAÇÃO
description:
Estamos à procura dos melhores dos melhores. Se você é proativo, altamente capacitado e domina operações marítimas , essa pode ser a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


O QUE BUSCAMOS?


✅ Experiência mínima de 4 anos na função de Operações Marítimas – Importação & Exportação

✅ Conhecimento sólido em documentação marítima (Bill of Lading, HBOL, MBOL)

✅ Capacidade de preencher e revisar documentos com precisão

✅ Habilidade para coordenar embarques do início ao fim

✅ Foco em soluções e atitude proativa

✅ Inglês escrito obrigatório, inglês falado é um diferencial

✅ Proficiência comprovada na função


⚠️ Apenas candidatos que estejam atualmente empregados na função ou cuja última experiência tenha sido na mesma posição serão considerados.


Salário: a definir com base na experiência.

Exigência: Computador próprio e confiável para trabalho remoto.

Contratação até 19 de Dezembro


Se você se encaixa no perfil e quer trabalhar em um ambiente onde apenas os melhores prosperam, envie seu currículo agora.

title: Account Assistant – Social Creators (Júnior)
description:
A WIP é um estúdio de design de narrativa que une storytelling e branding de forma estratégica, fazendo gestão de criadores e conteúdos para gerar impacto cultural através das marcas. Trabalhamos com métodos proprietários e processos ágeis para desenvolver narrativas e projetos que conectam, engajam e geram valor real.


Sobre o cargo


Como Account Assistant – Social Creators (Júnior), você será responsável por dar suporte ao time na operação do dia a dia com criadores de conteúdo.

O foco da vaga é organização, acompanhamento das entregas e apoio na comunicação com criadores e clientes.


É uma vaga para quem está começando no mercado, gosta do universo de conteúdo e quer aprender rápido sobre influência, redes sociais e rotinas de campanhas.


Responsabilidades principais


  • Dar apoio nas primeiras conversas com criadores (envio de informações, coleta de valores e detalhes básicos);
  • Acompanhar criadores após a contratação (repassar briefings, tirar dúvidas simples, organizar prazos e entregas);
  • Garantir atualização das informações em planilhas e sistemas internos;
  • Ajudar no controle de entregas (roteiros, vídeos, posts, stories, prazos e refações);
  • Fazer checklists, atualizar status e apoiar no envio de materiais para aprovadores;
  • Auxiliar na organização de reuniões, pautas e acompanhamentos;
  • Pesquisar tendências de redes sociais e referências simples para apoiar os projetos;
  • Ajudar no mapeamento inicial de criadores, buscando perfis alinhados ao briefing.


Qualidades esperadas


  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para lidar com pessoas;
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes (vai lidar com prazos e muitas informações);
  • Vontade de aprender e crescer no universo de criadores;
  • Perfil proativo, colaborativo e com boa gestão de prioridades;
  • Fluência em espanhol (obrigatório).


Ferramentas utilizadas

﻿

  • Influency.me
  • Social Blade
  • TikTok, Instagram, YouTube e Twitch
  • Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive)
  • Canva
  • Monday
  • Slack

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Somos uma consultoria especializada em TI , apaixonada por desafios e comprometida em impulsionar transformações tecnológicas estratégicas para nossos clientes. Se você busca crescimento profissional e deseja atuar em projetos inovadores, essa oportunidade é para você.


Modelo de contratação: PJ

Modalidade: Home Office


Requisitos

• Experiência prática em Azure DevOps (Repos, Pipelines, Boards, Artifacts).

• Conhecimento em CI/CD, Git, YAML pipelines e automação de builds/deploys.

• Vivência em gestão de acesso e políticas de segurança no Azure.

• Familiaridade com PowerShell, Terraform, ARM Templates ou Bicep para infraestrutura

como código.

• Capacidade de auditar e organizar ambientes legados, propondo melhorias de

governança.

• Boa comunicação e autonomia para interagir com áreas de desenvolvimento, segurança e

infraestrutura.

• Excelente comunicação e capacidade de traduzir linguagem técnica em

impacto de negócio.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Principais Atividades e Desafios:

• Estruturar e implantar a governança completa do Azure DevOps, incluindo políticas,

permissões, pipelines e controles de acesso.

• Implementar proteção do código-fonte (branch policies, code reviews obrigatórios, gestão

de secrets e credenciais).

• Revisar e organizar repositórios existentes, garantindo versionamento adequado e

padronização de nomenclaturas.

• Automatizar pipelines de CI/CD para garantir entregas consistentes e seguras.

• Integrar processos de DevOps com Azure, GitHub, Power BI, SonarQube ou ferramentas

de monitoramento.

• Apoiar squads e desenvolvedores na adoção de boas práticas de versionamento, build e

release.

• Monitorar e manter segurança, compliance e performance do ambiente de DevOps.


Diferenciais:

• Certificação Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert.

• Experiência em integração DevSecOps.

• Conhecimento em políticas de proteção de código e auditoria em ambientes regulados.

• Vivência em automação de governança (Policy as Code, GitHub Advanced Security, etc.).


Se identificou com a oportunidade? Envie seu CV e venha fazer parte do nosso time.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack
description:
VAGA ABERTA: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior – Remoto


Em busca de uma carreira em uma empresa que valoriza a flexibilidade, desenvolvimento pessoal e sucesso da equipe? Com 28 anos de experiência e reconhecidos pelo GPTW pelo quinto ano consecutivo, estamos em busca de talentos para se juntarem a nós como Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack . Com matriz no Brasil e filiais em território internacional, oferecemos oportunidades para crescimento e desenvolvimento. Candidate-se agora e faça parte de uma equipe que transforma negócios e realiza sonhos!


Requisitos essenciais:


  • Sólida experiência com C#, .NET Framework e .NET Core;
  • Forte conhecimento em Front-End, incluindo HTML, CSS, JavaScript e React;
  • Domínio de bancos de dados relacionais (MS-SQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL etc.) e NoSQL (MongoDB ou similares);
  • Vivência com fluxos de desenvolvimento modernos, GIT, testes, revisão de código, boas práticas, clean code e qualidade de software.


Requisitos adicionais:


  • Boa comunicação, trabalho em equipe, relacionamento com usuários e stakeholders, iniciativa e foco em resultados;
  • Conhecimento em mensagerias modernas (RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, Kafka, Pub/Sub, SQS, entre outros);
  • Experiência com Node.js, Python (Django, FastAPI);
  • Atuação em ambientes de nuvem — especialmente GCP — além de práticas de CI/CD, observabilidade e monitoração;
  • Vivência com Windows Server, incluindo IIS, MSMQ, serviços e rotinas;
  • Conhecimento em outros frameworks frontend (Angular, Vue);
  • Experiência com microsserviços, modernização e migração de monolitos;
  • Domínio de Docker, Kubernetes e soluções serverless (cloud ou on-premises);
  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a eventos e diversos design patterns;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Vivência com ferramentas de inteligência artificial, como ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, plataformas de geração de imagens ou automação de processos, aplicadas a: Automatização de tarefas, criação de relatórios e análise de dados, apoio à tomada de decisão e inovação contínua, melhoria da eficiência operacional e qualidade das entregas.


Responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver soluções completas, atuando tanto no backend quanto na interface do usuário;
  • Implementar e manter APIs REST e GraphQL, garantindo performance, segurança e qualidade;
  • Colaborar com equipes de DevOps para otimizar pipelines, ambientes e infraestrutura;
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, promovendo boas práticas de codificação, testes e arquitetura;
  • Participar de decisões técnicas, revisões de código e definição de padrões de desenvolvimento.

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking a DevOps / Technical Support Engineer to support a development team working on the internationalization and maintenance of a large-scale e-commerce platform. The environment consists of a distributed microservices architecture deployed on on-premises Kubernetes clusters and virtual machines , requiring hands-on troubleshooting, deployment operations, and strong coordination with engineering teams and clients. This role is highly technical and involves active participation in English-speaking client meetings and collaboration across multiple teams.


Responsibilities

  • Support the development team responsible for translating and adapting a distributed microservices e-commerce platform.
  • Manage and troubleshoot Kubernetes microservice deployments using Helm charts.
  • Operate and maintain Jenkins CI/CD pipelines; diagnose and resolve failures in automated deployment processes.
  • Collaborate closely with Java and Python development teams to understand deployment requirements.
  • Troubleshoot client ecosystem tools based on Jenkins self-service pipelines.
  • Support backend technologies such as PostgreSQL and Kafka, handling configuration, connectivity, and integration issues.
  • Retrieve and analyze logs from Kubernetes pods and on-prem VMs using Grafana, ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), and Jenkins logs.
  • Participate in English-speaking client meetings to gather requirements, clarify needs, and provide updates.
  • Manage work using a Kanban workflow.
  • Contribute to improvements in deployment processes, documentation, monitoring, and troubleshooting procedures.


Required Qualifications

  • Experience with Kubernetes, Helm, and containerized deployments in on-premise environments.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, especially Jenkins.
  • Basic to intermediate experience with microservices written in Java and Python.
  • Familiarity with PostgreSQL and Kafka.
  • Ability to diagnose distributed system issues using logs, dashboards, and monitoring tools (Grafana, ELK, etc.).
  • Experience with on-premises infrastructure.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to participate confidently in English-speaking client meetings.
  • Experience with Agile/Kanban methodologies.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in complex environments.
  • Proven experience troubleshooting legacy systems built in Java.


Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with large enterprise e-commerce platforms.
  • Knowledge of networking, authentication, and authorization concepts.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages such as Bash or Python.
  • Experience with Groovy for Jenkins Pipeline-as-Code.


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

description:

title: Podcast Producer
description:
Podcast Producer (Full-Service Management) – Sofia Health


Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Role


Sofia Health is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Podcast Producer to manage the full production workflow of our weekly interview podcast, Sofia Unfiltered. This role handles guest communication, scheduling, episode preparation, editorial coordination, and project management from pre-production through publishing.


We interview physicians, psychologists, authors, wellness experts, and thought leaders. You must be able to communicate professionally, manage multiple moving pieces, and maintain a calm, supportive tone consistent with our brand.


⭐What You’ll Do (Responsibilities) Guest Communication & Outreach
  • Manage all communication with guests from initial outreach to post-episode follow-up
  • Schedule interviews, send confirmations/reminders, and provide prep materials
  • Collect bios, headshots, books, links, and required release forms
  • Draft guest outreach emails and pitch new guests aligned with upcoming content themes
  • Maintain guest pipeline, schedules, and assets in Notion/Google Drive


Episode Planning & Production
  • Prepare episode briefs and host prep sheets
  • Attend live recordings (optional but preferred) to track timestamps and notes
  • Review raw audio/video and provide clear, detailed edit notes to the editor
  • Restructure episodes when needed for clarity, flow, and narrative arc
  • Collaborate on episode titles, angles, hooks, and story direction
  • Choose main promotional clips and quotes for social content


Editing Coordination
  • Send the editor cut notes that are clear, accurate, and time-stamped
  • Review first edit, request revisions, and ensure quality before publishing
  • Ensure the final episode reflects brand voice, pacing, clarity, and guest experience


Publishing & Show Management
  • Write compelling show notes, descriptions, summaries, and timestamps
  • Prepare publishing assets (titles, tags, categories, episode artwork if needed)
  • Upload weekly episodes to our hosting platform (Spotify for Podcasters or similar)
  • Track episode performance metrics and maintain publishing calendar


Marketing & Promotion Support
  • Coordinate with the social media team to deliver clips, quotes, and captions
  • Identify promotional opportunities through guests’ audiences
  • Support the creation of audiograms, reels, and short-form content briefs


Monetization & Growth
  • Assist in creating sponsorship decks and packages
  • Research relevant brand partners to pitch
  • Coordinate guest cross-promotion to increase downloads
  • Identify podcast swaps and collaboration opportunities
  • Track growth trends and propose strategies to expand reach


Host & Media Outreach (Podcast Guest Booking)


  • Research aligned podcasts across wellness, entrepreneurship, marketing, leadership, mental health, women’s health, lifestyle medicine, and business growth
  • Create a list of high-quality podcasts suitable for Riley as a guest
  • Draft personalized podcast pitches in Riley’s voice
  • Send and manage outreach emails to podcast hosts and producers
  • Track outreach, follow-ups, and confirmed appearances in Notion or a CRM
  • Coordinate scheduling, prep materials, and talking points
  • Prepare Riley with a one-sheet, interview brief, and relevant episodes of the host
  • Identify opportunities for backlinks, newsletter swaps, and co-marketing
  • Track results and optimize pitches based on acceptance rates



You’re a Great Fit If You…


  • Have real podcast producing experience (required—not entry-level)
  • Have excellent written English and can write in a warm, professional tone
  • Are organized and reliable with strong project management skills
  • Love structure, systems, checklists, and keeping details tight
  • Can communicate confidently with high-profile guests
  • Can listen to an episode and identify what needs to be cut for clarity and flow
  • Are comfortable giving editors detailed, accurate instructions
  • Enjoy managing timelines, assets, and follow-ups
  • Can work independently and solve problems proactively
  • Are calm under pressure and able to meet weekly deadlines


⭐ Required Skills & Experience
  • 2+ years experience as a Podcast Producer , Podcast Manager , or similar
  • Experience working with audio/video editors
  • Strong writing and communication skills
  • Ability to review episodes and give editorial direction
  • Experience managing guests and scheduling interviews
  • Familiarity with publishing platforms (Spotify for Podcasters, Buzzsprout, etc.)
  • Strong organizational skills with tools like Notion, Trello, Asana, or Airtable
  • Comfortable coordinating social media assets
  • Ability to work in US time zones when needed


Bonus:

  • Experience with sponsorship outreach or monetization
  • Background in wellness, psychology, health, or coaching content
  • Experience producing long-form interview-style shows
  • Ability to identify clips for short-form video

title: Graphic Designer (Motion)
description:
We’re looking for a Graphic Designer with strong design fundamentals, an eye for storytelling, and the ability to bring visuals to life through motion. You’ll work across social content, digital graphics, brand design, presentations, and motion graphics.

This role is perfect for someone who loves blending design, animation, and smart use of modern tools and AI to create scroll-stopping, brand-aligned content. If you’re detail-oriented, enjoy working across formats, collaborate well with a creative team, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, you’ll fit right in.


What you'll do

  • Design high-quality social media creative, digital graphics, presentations, and branded visual systems across multiple formats and platforms.
  • Create motion graphics and animated elements — including transitions, text animations, graphics packages, and lightweight video edits for short-form content.
  • Apply brand guidelines consistently while finding space for creativity and innovation.
  • Use AI and modern creative tools to speed up ideation, design variations, motion workflows, and content exploration.
  • Collaborate with creative leads and project managers to clarify briefs, address feedback and ensure on-time delivery.
  • Maintain clean, organised files and a high standard of craft across motion and static work.


What you'll bring

  • 2+ years of experience as a Graphic Designer, Motion Designer, or hybrid creative role.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing brand design, social content, motion graphics, and layout expertise.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite and strong working knowledge of Figma and presentation design tools.
  • Understanding of visual hierarchy, typography, colour systems, and brand identity.
  • Ability to animate and design for modern platforms (Reels, TikTok, YouTube, paid social, etc).
  • Familiarity with AI or automation tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Runway and Midjourney).
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with tight timelines and evolving briefs.
  • A collaborative mindset, strong attention to detail, and an ability to embrace and act on feedback.
  • Clear and confident communication in English, with the ability to explain design decisions and collaborate effectively with both creatives and project managers.


Why join SoCreative?

We help brands like American Express, Johnson & Johnson, Google, Schneider Electric and Toyota scale video and design content with speed, consistency, and creativity. Our workflow is built for momentum — pairing great talent with streamlined processes, smart tech and a global, supportive team.


At SoCreative, you’ll have the chance to:

  • Work with ambitious brands across video, design, and motion formats.
  • Collaborate with world-class creatives around the globe.
  • Grow quickly in a company shaping how modern creative production works.
  • Take ownership of your work and contribute meaningfully to projects that move fast and have real impact.

title: Creative Production Lead
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!

﻿

About Olly Olly

Ready to roll up your sleeves and help transform local marketing forever? At Olly Olly, we're blending technology and real-world expertise to empower small businesses across the U.S. like never before.


We believe small businesses are the backbone of our economy. That's why we're on a mission to provide them with tools, strategies, and insights that help them rank higher, generate high-quality leads, get calls and reviews, and grow sustainably without the hassle.


The Olly Olly platform complements our hands-on service perfectly: it's no-nonsense, easy-to-use software that helps local businesses streamline operations, drive leads, and maximize revenue with minimal effort so they can focus on what they do best.


Why We Need You

You have the eye. You can look at a website for five seconds and know whether it builds trust or destroys it. You see the logo that looks like a 2008 Fiverr special, the stock photo that screams "we didn't try," the typography that signals cheap. And it bothers you. Physically.


We're building a production team that creates websites, logos, and visual assets for 4,000+ local service businesses—contractors, plumbers, attorneys, HVAC companies. These businesses live or die by how professional they look online. Your job is to make sure everything we ship makes them look like the best option in their market.


As Creative Production Lead , you'll manage a team of designers who assemble websites from content, photos, and structured data. You're not just assigning tickets. You're inspecting work daily, catching the details that kill credibility, coaching your team to see what you see, and refusing to let "good enough" out the door.


You can also DO the work yourself. When a logo needs to be created or fixed, you're not waiting for someone else. When a layout isn't working, you can open the file and make it better. You lead by example because you're a designer first, manager second.


The Impact You'll Have

  • Quality is your obsession. You review completed work daily—not for completion, but for excellence. You catch the weak logo, the amateur photo crop, the layout that buries the CTA, the color palette that feels dated. Nothing ships unless it meets your standards.
  • You inspect, you coach, you elevate. You're providing specific feedback on real work: "This logo doesn't work because the type is fighting the icon." "This hero image undermines trust—the lighting looks fake." "This layout guides the eye away from what matters." You're building your team's taste through detailed critiques.
  • You stay fluid. What looked great two years ago looks tired today. You're constantly studying what's working across industries, updating standards, killing approaches that stopped converting. When you spot a pattern that works, you train the team on it immediately.
  • You execute when needed. Logo needs a refresh? You can do it. Layout falling apart? You fix it. You're not above the work—you're the best at it.
  • You run production, not a gallery. This is high-volume. Your team handles hundreds of sites and thousands of updates monthly. You understand that speed and quality aren't opposites—they require discipline, systems, and people who give a damn.


What We Really Need From You

Core Requirements

  • 5+ years in visual design with a portfolio that demonstrates genuine taste—not just competence, but an eye for what converts vs. what just exists
  • 2+ years leading or managing a design team—you've held people to standards, given hard feedback, and developed talent
  • Hands-on execution skills: you can create and refine logos, fix layouts, improve visual hierarchy yourself
  • Production experience: you've worked in environments where volume mattered—agencies, e-commerce, high-output teams
  • Quality obsession: you reject work that's "fine" because fine doesn't win


What Would Be Big Pluses

  • Background in advertising, branding agencies, or e-commerce design
  • Experience with WordPress page builders (Elementor, WP Bakery, Divi, Gutenberg)—or willingness to learn fast
  • Understanding of conversion principles: what builds trust, what drives action
  • Experience building or maintaining design systems
  • Knowledge of SEO basics and how design choices impact performance


We'll teach you:

  • Our specific tools and workflows
  • WordPress/Elementor if you don't know them (you'll pick it up in a week)
  • Our brand guidelines and quality standards
  • The local service business landscape


What You'll Love About Working at Olly Olly

  • Salary: Competitive (based on experience and location)
  • Flexible work: 100% remote, core hours 8 AM – 5 PM EST for collaboration
  • Work-life balance: 15 vacation days + U.S. holidays
  • Growth path: This role leads to Director of Creative Production or VP of Creative. You'll build the team, the systems, and the culture.
  • Real impact: Your standards directly determine whether 17,000+ small businesses look like winners or also-rans.


Why Choose Us?

We're evolving from template-driven agency work to genuinely differentiated design. You'll build a team culture where craft matters, where mediocrity gets rejected, and where the work actually helps small businesses compete.


Diversity and Inclusion at Olly Olly

At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here—and your unique perspective helps us shape the future of small business growth.

title: Podcast Producer
description:
Podcast Producer (Full-Service Management) – Sofia Health


Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Role


Sofia Health is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Podcast Producer to manage the full production workflow of our weekly interview podcast, Sofia Unfiltered. This role handles guest communication, scheduling, episode preparation, editorial coordination, and project management from pre-production through publishing.


We interview physicians, psychologists, authors, wellness experts, and thought leaders. You must be able to communicate professionally, manage multiple moving pieces, and maintain a calm, supportive tone consistent with our brand.


⭐What You’ll Do (Responsibilities) Guest Communication & Outreach
  • Manage all communication with guests from initial outreach to post-episode follow-up
  • Schedule interviews, send confirmations/reminders, and provide prep materials
  • Collect bios, headshots, books, links, and required release forms
  • Draft guest outreach emails and pitch new guests aligned with upcoming content themes
  • Maintain guest pipeline, schedules, and assets in Notion/Google Drive


Episode Planning & Production
  • Prepare episode briefs and host prep sheets
  • Attend live recordings (optional but preferred) to track timestamps and notes
  • Review raw audio/video and provide clear, detailed edit notes to the editor
  • Restructure episodes when needed for clarity, flow, and narrative arc
  • Collaborate on episode titles, angles, hooks, and story direction
  • Choose main promotional clips and quotes for social content


Editing Coordination
  • Send the editor cut notes that are clear, accurate, and time-stamped
  • Review first edit, request revisions, and ensure quality before publishing
  • Ensure the final episode reflects brand voice, pacing, clarity, and guest experience


Publishing & Show Management
  • Write compelling show notes, descriptions, summaries, and timestamps
  • Prepare publishing assets (titles, tags, categories, episode artwork if needed)
  • Upload weekly episodes to our hosting platform (Spotify for Podcasters or similar)
  • Track episode performance metrics and maintain publishing calendar


Marketing & Promotion Support
  • Coordinate with the social media team to deliver clips, quotes, and captions
  • Identify promotional opportunities through guests’ audiences
  • Support the creation of audiograms, reels, and short-form content briefs


Monetization & Growth
  • Assist in creating sponsorship decks and packages
  • Research relevant brand partners to pitch
  • Coordinate guest cross-promotion to increase downloads
  • Identify podcast swaps and collaboration opportunities
  • Track growth trends and propose strategies to expand reach


Host & Media Outreach (Podcast Guest Booking)


  • Research aligned podcasts across wellness, entrepreneurship, marketing, leadership, mental health, women’s health, lifestyle medicine, and business growth
  • Create a list of high-quality podcasts suitable for Riley as a guest
  • Draft personalized podcast pitches in Riley’s voice
  • Send and manage outreach emails to podcast hosts and producers
  • Track outreach, follow-ups, and confirmed appearances in Notion or a CRM
  • Coordinate scheduling, prep materials, and talking points
  • Prepare Riley with a one-sheet, interview brief, and relevant episodes of the host
  • Identify opportunities for backlinks, newsletter swaps, and co-marketing
  • Track results and optimize pitches based on acceptance rates



You’re a Great Fit If You…


  • Have real podcast producing experience (required—not entry-level)
  • Have excellent written English and can write in a warm, professional tone
  • Are organized and reliable with strong project management skills
  • Love structure, systems, checklists, and keeping details tight
  • Can communicate confidently with high-profile guests
  • Can listen to an episode and identify what needs to be cut for clarity and flow
  • Are comfortable giving editors detailed, accurate instructions
  • Enjoy managing timelines, assets, and follow-ups
  • Can work independently and solve problems proactively
  • Are calm under pressure and able to meet weekly deadlines


⭐ Required Skills & Experience
  • 2+ years experience as a Podcast Producer , Podcast Manager , or similar
  • Experience working with audio/video editors
  • Strong writing and communication skills
  • Ability to review episodes and give editorial direction
  • Experience managing guests and scheduling interviews
  • Familiarity with publishing platforms (Spotify for Podcasters, Buzzsprout, etc.)
  • Strong organizational skills with tools like Notion, Trello, Asana, or Airtable
  • Comfortable coordinating social media assets
  • Ability to work in US time zones when needed


Bonus:

  • Experience with sponsorship outreach or monetization
  • Background in wellness, psychology, health, or coaching content
  • Experience producing long-form interview-style shows
  • Ability to identify clips for short-form video

title: Contact Center Executive - Customer Service
description:
About Us:


HBX Group is the world’s leading technology partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality. We’re headquartered in Palma, Mallorca and employ around 3,500 people worldwide.


We are seeking a Global Contact Center Executive to join our dynamic Contact Center team. In this role, you will support our clients and suppliers, contributing to one of our core missions: delivering unique holiday experiences to our customers . This opportunity is open to candidates currently residing in Jundiaí .


Role Overview

The primary responsibility of this role is to assist clients—including tour operators, travel agencies, and end customers—with their inquiries, liaise with suppliers, and manage bookings in alignment with the standards and procedures of the Operations Department. The goal is to address client needs efficiently and effectively.


Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with callers in a professional and enthusiastic manner, representing HBX Group with excellence.
  • Provide accurate and helpful information in response to client inquiries.
  • Document all call activity clearly and accurately in the Back Office system.
  • Respond promptly and precisely to online and email requests.
  • Monitor and manage bookings, including reservations, special requests, amendments, and cancellations.
  • Escalate issues appropriately, following Contact Center protocols.
  • Maintain high standards of service quality and professionalism.
  • Meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Adhere to all company policies and procedures.
  • Follow assigned schedules and adapt to changes based on call volume.


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong customer service orientation and active listening skills.
  • Proficiency in English (spoken and written).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, with attention to grammar and clarity.
  • Problem-solving mindset with persistence in resolving issues accurately and efficiently.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions independently.
  • High attention to detail and adaptability.
  • Consistent focus and enthusiasm throughout the work shift.


If you are passionate about customer service, communication, and creative problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today!


Note: Only candidates currently living in Jundiaí will be considered for this position in the Hybrid Model.



At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking a DevOps / Technical Support Engineer to support a development team working on the internationalization and maintenance of a large-scale e-commerce platform. The environment consists of a distributed microservices architecture deployed on on-premises Kubernetes clusters and virtual machines , requiring hands-on troubleshooting, deployment operations, and strong coordination with engineering teams and clients. This role is highly technical and involves active participation in English-speaking client meetings and collaboration across multiple teams.


Responsibilities

  • Support the development team responsible for translating and adapting a distributed microservices e-commerce platform.
  • Manage and troubleshoot Kubernetes microservice deployments using Helm charts.
  • Operate and maintain Jenkins CI/CD pipelines; diagnose and resolve failures in automated deployment processes.
  • Collaborate closely with Java and Python development teams to understand deployment requirements.
  • Troubleshoot client ecosystem tools based on Jenkins self-service pipelines.
  • Support backend technologies such as PostgreSQL and Kafka, handling configuration, connectivity, and integration issues.
  • Retrieve and analyze logs from Kubernetes pods and on-prem VMs using Grafana, ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), and Jenkins logs.
  • Participate in English-speaking client meetings to gather requirements, clarify needs, and provide updates.
  • Manage work using a Kanban workflow.
  • Contribute to improvements in deployment processes, documentation, monitoring, and troubleshooting procedures.


Required Qualifications

  • Experience with Kubernetes, Helm, and containerized deployments in on-premise environments.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, especially Jenkins.
  • Basic to intermediate experience with microservices written in Java and Python.
  • Familiarity with PostgreSQL and Kafka.
  • Ability to diagnose distributed system issues using logs, dashboards, and monitoring tools (Grafana, ELK, etc.).
  • Experience with on-premises infrastructure.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to participate confidently in English-speaking client meetings.
  • Experience with Agile/Kanban methodologies.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in complex environments.
  • Proven experience troubleshooting legacy systems built in Java.


Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with large enterprise e-commerce platforms.
  • Knowledge of networking, authentication, and authorization concepts.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages such as Bash or Python.
  • Experience with Groovy for Jenkins Pipeline-as-Code.


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.
