title: Desenvolvedor Java PL
description:
Quem Somos

“A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a DEXIAN® atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de “staffing augmentation” dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.


O que esperar de nós

É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras; comprometimento não é só um pensamento; e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Essa vaga irá atender nosso cliente no segmento industrial.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

Profissional responsável por desenvolver, manter e evoluir aplicações Java, assegurando estabilidade, performance, segurança e qualidade técnica.

Atuará tanto em sistemas modernos quanto em soluções legadas, exigindo capacidade de leitura de código pré-existente, raciocínio investigativo e habilidade para trabalhar com informações limitadas.

Também será responsável por integrar aplicações internas e externas, otimizar rotinas de banco de dados e garantir aderência às regras de negócio e padrões arquiteturais estabelecidos.

• Investigar e identificar causas raízes de problemas utilizando logs, métricas, comportamento da aplicação e leitura de código.

• Desenvolver e manter APIs, componentes backend e integrações entre sistemas.

• Propor, implementar e validar soluções robustas e eficientes, garantindo qualidade, segurança e estabilidade.

• Evoluir sistemas existentes, preservando compatibilidade com soluções legadas.

• Realizar ajustes estruturais e otimizações de desempenho.

• Apoiar squads internos (negócio, infraestrutura, QA) para garantir fluidez na entrega e operação diária.

• Participar de code reviews, boas práticas de engenharia e iniciativas de melhoria contínua.


O que você precisa ter:

• Experiência sólida com Java 8+ em ambientes corporativos.

• Domínio de frameworks como Spring, Spring Boot, Spring MVC.

• Implementação de APIs REST e SOAP com boas práticas de segurança e versionamento.

• Experiência com servidores de aplicação: Tomcat, WildFly/JBoss ou equivalentes.

• Desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs REST/SOAP.

• Manipulação de arquivos CSV, TXT, XML.

• Familiaridade com integrações legadas e arquiteturas híbridas.

• SQL avançado: joins complexos, triggers, views, procedures.

• Experiência com Oracle, SQL Server ou PostgreSQL.

• Capacidade de tuning, otimização de consultas e análise de planos de execução.

• Construção e manutenção de scripts e rotinas de banco.

• Uso de ferramentas de versionamento, especialmente Git.

• Conhecimento de logs, monitoramento e ferramentas de troubleshooting.

• Experiência com ambientes Linux e execução de serviços Java.

Soft skills: Perfil Comportamental

• Raciocínio analítico e foco em resolução estruturada de problemas.

• Organização e clareza na documentação técnica.

• Boa comunicação com áreas técnicas, de negócio e demais stakeholders.

• Proatividade e autonomia diante de cenários com documentação limitada.

• Conforto para trabalhar com código legado, mantendo disciplina e visão de melhoria contínua.

• Capacidade de lidar com múltiplas demandas e mudanças de prioridade.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

title: Desenvolvedor Delphi PL
description:
Quem Somos

“A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. O que esperar de nós

É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras; comprometimento não é só um pensamento; e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Essa vaga irá atender nosso cliente no segmento industrial.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

Profissional responsável por desenvolver, manter e evoluir aplicações Delphi, assegurando estabilidade, performance, qualidade técnica e aderência às regras de negócio. Atuará tanto em sistemas modernos quanto em soluções legadas, exigindo capacidade de leitura de código pré-existente, raciocínio investigativo e habilidade para trabalhar com informações limitadas. Também será responsável por integrar aplicações internas e externas, além de otimizar rotinas de banco de dados críticas para o negócio.

Atividades que este profissional irá exercer : Principais Atividades

• Investigar e identificar causas raízes de problemas com base em logs, comportamento da aplicação e leitura detalhada do código.

• Propor, implementar e validar soluções práticas e eficientes, garantindo qualidade e estabilidade do sistema.

• Desenvolver novas funcionalidades e correções, preservando compatibilidade com o ambiente legado.

• Contribuir para melhoria contínua dos sistemas, incluindo refatorações, ajustes estruturais e otimizações de desempenho.

• Colaborar com equipes internas (negócio, infraestrutura, qualidade) garantindo fluidez na entrega e na operação diária.


O que você precisa ter:

• Experiência sólida com Delphi em ambientes corporativos.

• Domínio de VCL, incluindo componentes visuais e não visuais.

• Desenvolvimento e manutenção de EXEs, DLLs e bibliotecas internas.

• Manipulação de componentes de acesso a dados: FireDAC, dbExpress, BDE (ambientes legados).

• Experiência com integrações: REST, SOAP e manipulação de arquivos.

• SQL avançado: joins complexos, procedures, triggers e views.

• Vivência com Oracle, SQL Server ou PostgreSQL.

• Capacidade de tuning e otimização de consultas.

• Criação e manutenção de scripts e rotinas de banco de dados.

• Consumo e criação de APIs REST e SOAP.

• Manipulação de arquivos CSV, TXT, XML e integrações via SFTP/FTP.

• Familiaridade com webservices legados e arquiteturas pouco documentadas.

Soft skills: Perfil Comportamental

• Raciocínio analítico e foco em resolução estruturada de problemas.

• Organização e clareza na documentação técnica.

• Boa comunicação com áreas técnicas, de negócio e demais stakeholders.

• Proatividade e autonomia diante de cenários com documentação limitada.

• Conforto para trabalhar com código legado, mantendo disciplina e visão de melhoria contínua.

• Capacidade de lidar com múltiplas demandas e mudanças de prioridade.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Regime Remoto.

title: Diretor Escolar
description:
Este cargo estará localizado em uma escola no Brasil; não é remoto.


Com a expansão da International Schools Partnership pel, buscamos Diretores, Vice-diretores e Líderes Seniores com sólida experiência em educação K-12 e histórico comprovado de melhoria escolar. Procuramos líderes apaixonados pela Excelência Acadêmica , com visão operacional e mentalidade comercial para gerir escolas de alto desempenho.

Junte-se a uma rede global dedicada a fortalecer líderes escolares, promover inovação e transformar positivamente comunidades educacionais em toda a região.


Sobre a International Schools Partnership

A International Schools Partnership é um grupo global em crescimento, com 114 escolas internacionais privadas em 25 países, atendendo mais de 92.500 estudantes.

Nossa missão é apoiar nossas escolas para que se tornem a principal escolha em suas comunidades, estabelecendo novos padrões de qualidade, preparando estudantes para o futuro e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento das comunidades onde atuam.


Por que construir sua carreira na International Schools Partnership?

  • Visão Global: Atue em um ambiente que valoriza a perspectiva internacional e a diversidade cultural.
  • Compromisso com a Excelência: Faça parte de um grupo focado em ensino e aprendizagem de alta qualidade.
  • Ambientes Modernos: Trabalhe em instalações inovadoras e bem equipadas.
  • Desenvolvimento em Liderança: Tenha acesso a formação contínua e oportunidades de crescimento global.


Propósito do Cargo

O Diretor lidera com visão e integridade, construindo uma cultura escolar segura, inclusiva e colaborativa onde o aprendizado prospera. Em parceria com sua equipe, famílias e a rede International Schools Partnership, posiciona a escola como uma “Escola de Escolha”, garantindo experiências e resultados acadêmicos excepcionais, impulsionando matrículas e retenção. Suas responsabilidades incluem salvaguarda, melhoria do ensino baseada em evidências, planejamento estratégico, engajamento da comunidade e desempenho comercial.

O Diretor se reporta ao Diretor Regional (RMD).


Responsabilidades-Chave

(Com peso igual de 25% cada)

  • Desenvolvimento e bem-estar da equipe
  • Resultados de aprendizado dos estudantes
  • Engajamento comunitário e experiência das famílias
  • Desempenho comercial


Competências-Chave

Planejamento estratégico, liderança educacional, gestão de proteção infantil, liderança inclusiva, inteligência emocional, construção de comunidade, engajamento de stakeholders, desenvolvimento de equipes, gestão de desempenho, comunicação eficaz, tomada de decisão baseada em dados, marketing educacional, finanças, gestão de mudança e colaboração.


Compromisso com a Proteção Infantil

A International Schools Partnership está comprometida com a segurança e o bem-estar de crianças e jovens. Todos os profissionais devem cumprir processos rigorosos de verificação de antecedentes referentes aos últimos 10 anos de experiência.


Compromisso com Diversidade, Inclusão e Pertencimento

A International Schools Partnership promove uma cultura inclusiva e acolhedora, contratando e desenvolvendo talentos independentemente de gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, idade, deficiência, neurodivergência ou origem socioeconômica. Encorajamos candidaturas de profissionais que compartilham nossos valores e desejam contribuir para o sucesso da organização.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About You

You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.

You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you’re curious about AI/ML integrations even if you’re not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
  • Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).
  • Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.
  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, PostgreSQL, or similar.
  • Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
  • Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).
  • Familiarity with graph databases, embeddings, or AI integrations from a data engineering perspective (nice to have).
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2+), able to work with global stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.
  • Implement and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with attention to performance, reliability, and cost.
  • Design and evolve data models and curated layers to support reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
  • Collaborate with analytics, AI/Data Science, and product teams to understand data requirements and SLAs.
  • Support AI and advanced analytics features by providing clean, well-structured, and reliable datasets.
  • Apply best practices around data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability.
  • Write maintainable, well-documented data code and contribute to shared standards and patterns.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and help improve overall data platform design.
  • (If senior/lead-leaning) Support or mentor less-experienced data engineers as the team grows.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Desenvolvedor Delphi PL
description:
Quem Somos

“A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a DEXIAN® atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de “staffing augmentation” dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.


O que esperar de nós

É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras; comprometimento não é só um pensamento; e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Essa vaga irá atender nosso cliente no segmento industrial.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

Profissional responsável por desenvolver, manter e evoluir aplicações Delphi, assegurando estabilidade, performance, qualidade técnica e aderência às regras de negócio. Atuará tanto em sistemas modernos quanto em soluções legadas, exigindo capacidade de leitura de código pré-existente, raciocínio investigativo e habilidade para trabalhar com informações limitadas. Também será responsável por integrar aplicações internas e externas, além de otimizar rotinas de banco de dados críticas para o negócio.

Atividades que este profissional irá exercer : Principais Atividades

• Investigar e identificar causas raízes de problemas com base em logs, comportamento da aplicação e leitura detalhada do código.

• Propor, implementar e validar soluções práticas e eficientes, garantindo qualidade e estabilidade do sistema.

title: Diretor Escolar
description:
Este cargo estará localizado em uma escola no Brasil; não é remoto.


Com a expansão da International Schools Partnership pel, buscamos Diretores, Vice-diretores e Líderes Seniores com sólida experiência em educação K-12 e histórico comprovado de melhoria escolar. Procuramos líderes apaixonados pela Excelência Acadêmica , com visão operacional e mentalidade comercial para gerir escolas de alto desempenho.

Junte-se a uma rede global dedicada a fortalecer líderes escolares, promover inovação e transformar positivamente comunidades educacionais em toda a região.


Sobre a International Schools Partnership

A International Schools Partnership é um grupo global em crescimento, com 114 escolas internacionais privadas em 25 países, atendendo mais de 92.500 estudantes.

Nossa missão é apoiar nossas escolas para que se tornem a principal escolha em suas comunidades, estabelecendo novos padrões de qualidade, preparando estudantes para o futuro e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento das comunidades onde atuam.


Por que construir sua carreira na International Schools Partnership?

  • Visão Global: Atue em um ambiente que valoriza a perspectiva internacional e a diversidade cultural.
  • Compromisso com a Excelência: Faça parte de um grupo focado em ensino e aprendizagem de alta qualidade.
  • Ambientes Modernos: Trabalhe em instalações inovadoras e bem equipadas.
  • Desenvolvimento em Liderança: Tenha acesso a formação contínua e oportunidades de crescimento global.


Propósito do Cargo

O Diretor lidera com visão e integridade, construindo uma cultura escolar segura, inclusiva e colaborativa onde o aprendizado prospera. Em parceria com sua equipe, famílias e a rede International Schools Partnership, posiciona a escola como uma “Escola de Escolha”, garantindo experiências e resultados acadêmicos excepcionais, impulsionando matrículas e retenção. Suas responsabilidades incluem salvaguarda, melhoria do ensino baseada em evidências, planejamento estratégico, engajamento da comunidade e desempenho comercial.

O Diretor se reporta ao Diretor Regional (RMD).


Responsabilidades-Chave

(Com peso igual de 25% cada)

  • Desenvolvimento e bem-estar da equipe
  • Resultados de aprendizado dos estudantes
  • Engajamento comunitário e experiência das famílias
  • Desempenho comercial


Competências-Chave

Planejamento estratégico, liderança educacional, gestão de proteção infantil, liderança inclusiva, inteligência emocional, construção de comunidade, engajamento de stakeholders, desenvolvimento de equipes, gestão de desempenho, comunicação eficaz, tomada de decisão baseada em dados, marketing educacional, finanças, gestão de mudança e colaboração.


Compromisso com a Proteção Infantil

A International Schools Partnership está comprometida com a segurança e o bem-estar de crianças e jovens. Todos os profissionais devem cumprir processos rigorosos de verificação de antecedentes referentes aos últimos 10 anos de experiência.


Compromisso com Diversidade, Inclusão e Pertencimento

A International Schools Partnership promove uma cultura inclusiva e acolhedora, contratando e desenvolvendo talentos independentemente de gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, idade, deficiência, neurodivergência ou origem socioeconômica. Encorajamos candidaturas de profissionais que compartilham nossos valores e desejam contribuir para o sucesso da organização.

title: Desenvolvedor Java PL
description:
Quem Somos

“A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a DEXIAN® atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de “staffing augmentation” dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.


O que esperar de nós

A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.

Essa vaga irá atender nosso cliente no segmento industrial.

title: Remote SAT English Tutor - 50997
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

Day-to-day responsibilities:

As an SAT Tutor, you will work remotely with high school students preparing for U.S. college admissions. Your sessions will focus on strengthening reading, writing, and mathematical reasoning skills using official materials and proven strategies. You’ll conduct timed practice tests, review performance, and create personalized study plans to help students maximize their scores. Clear communication, consistent feedback, and student motivation will be essential to building confidence and exam readiness.


Requirements:

We’re seeking experienced tutors with a strong record of preparing students for the SAT. Candidates should understand the digital SAT format, be familiar with College Board materials, and have excellent academic English skills. High SAT scores or standardized test prep certifications are preferred. Strong teaching abilities, virtual instruction skills, and a results-driven approach are essential. Communication in English: Ability to clearly convey feedback, nuances, and progress updates to the team.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: Availability of up to 40 hours per week is preferred
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract: 1 month
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los-Angeles


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will go through an interview.
  • Once you clear the interview, you are ready to go!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Electrical VDC Team Lead
description:
At Eracore, we’re committed to developing talented engineers and exposing them to some of the most exciting electrical projects in the country, while becoming the most trusted partners in the industry. From coordination and prefabrication to detailed shop drawings, we support some of the most complex and high-stakes electrical projects in the United States, including Data Centers, Government Facilities, Manufacturing Plants, and cutting-edge Commercial developments.


Under strong leadership, Eracore is quickly expanding their presence in Brazil. Our goal is to develop a team of the brightest minds to take on the biggest industry challenges on some of the coolest projects in the USA.


Visit our site to see some of our projects that we want you to be apart of --> eracore.com


Benefits of working with us:

  • Competitive Salary
  • Annual Bonus
  • Learning platforms that enable growth and development
  • Strong leadership and mentorship


Roles and Responsibilities

  • Oversee and lead the development, coordination, and delivery of Electrical BIM models across all project stages, ensuring compliance with project requirements, standards, and industry best practices.
  • Manage and guide the Electrical BIM team by providing technical support, quality checks, and mentorship to ensure accurate and efficient model development.
  • Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams (Mechanical, Architectural, Structural, and other engineering teams) to ensure effective model coordination and clash-free deliverables.
  • Conduct regular model audits, data checks, and quality control reviews to ensure the integrity and reliability of electrical BIM deliverables.
  • Prepare and deliver BIM-related documentation, including model execution plans, progress reports, schedules, and technical presentations.
  • Support the integration of BIM with other digital tools such as Navisworks, Revit and clash detection software for enhanced project delivery.
  • Identify process gaps and propose improvements to enhance BIM efficiency, model accuracy, and team productivity.
  • Train and upskill team members on BIM technologies, electrical modeling techniques, and emerging industry trends.
  • Coordinate with client BIM teams to understand project expectations, provide updates, and ensure smooth communication throughout the project lifecycle.


Qualifications

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in Electrical BIM modeling, coordination, and project delivery.
  • Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (Electrical discipline) with strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Strong experience using Navisworks for clash detection, coordination, and model review.
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, Bluebeam, and other industry tools.
  • Proven ability to lead, mentor, and guide juniors while maintaining high-quality output.
  • Ability to manage project timelines and client expectations.


Preferrable

  • Solid understanding of U.S. construction practices, NEC codes, and electrical engineering principle.
  • Experience in developing BIM standards, workflows, and templates for electrical systems.
  • Prior experience working on Data Centers.

description:
Shopify Developer

Remote (Brazil/Argentina)

Contract


Position Description

Navigate complex challenges and is deeply committed to building robust, top‑notch technological solutions.


Key Accountabilities / Responsibilities

  • Cloud Implementation and Management
  • Design, implement, and optimize Shopify cloud solutions and associated products, ensuring scalability, security, and efficiency while collaborating with the IT security team for compliance.

  • Develop robust and secure RESTful APIs for integration and external communications, and maintain the frontend of the Distributor Vendor Tool using modern JavaScript frameworks, ensuring responsive and optimal user experiences.

Leadership Competencies / Qualifications

  • Educational and Experience Requirements: Bachelor’s degree with 8+ years in software engineering, development, and e‑commerce solution architecture, with specific focus on Shopify.

  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in API technologies (SOAP, REST), Middleware tools (e.g., Cast Iron, MuleSoft), and web application design and analysis, including design patterns and object‑oriented design.
  • Customization and Front‑end Development: Experience in customizing Shopify’s front‑end components using layout XML, blocks, components, templates, and React.
  • ERP and Third‑party Services Integration: Knowledge of integrating Shopify with enterprise ERP systems and utilizing third‑party web services.
  • Store Management Expertise: Comprehensive understanding of Store Catalog (categories/products/attributes) and Sales Orders (quotes/orders/invoices/shipments/credits) processes.

description:
Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Experiência com C# e .NET/Core;

- Domínio de bancos de dados Oracle e SQL Server, incluindo criação de procedures, views e otimização de consultas;

- Vivência com Windows Forms para manutenção e evolução de aplicações legadas;

- Desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs RESTful;

- Conhecimento sólido em programação orientada a objetos e aplicação de princípios SOLID;

- Prática com padrões de design (Design Patterns);

- Utilização de GIT para versionamento e controle de código-fonte;

- Conhecimento em frameworks front-end modernos, como React e Angular, desejável;

- Inglês intermediário ou avançado para leitura, escrita e conversação técnica;


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️


About Uitify


Uitify is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.


The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience;
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on cybersecurity trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Uitify, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Venture Capital Analyst
description:
About Evvolve & Partners

Evvolve & Partners is a global financial and strategic advisory firm that connects visionary entrepreneurs with strategic capital. We support innovative companies in scaling through high-impact capital partnerships, leveraging our international investor network, deep market intelligence, and long-term value–driven approach. Our work goes beyond traditional capital matchmaking—combining proprietary sourcing, strategic insight, and a commitment to supporting founders throughout their growth journey.


Role Overview

We are seeking a highly organized and analytically minded Venture Capital Analyst with a strong focus on developing investor-facing materials. In this role, you will craft, refine, and manage core content that supports our portfolio companies throughout their fundraising journeys—including pitch decks, one-pagers, and strategic narratives.


This position is ideal for someone who understands the venture landscape and excels at translating complex business models into compelling investment materials. You will collaborate with internal teams, portfolio founders, and design partners to ensure each presentation is both insightful and visually aligned with Evvolve’s high standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the creation, iteration, and finalization of investment materials (e.g., pitch decks, one-pagers, fundraising briefs).
  • Synthesize business models, market analyses, and competitive landscapes into concise and impactful presentations.
  • Collaborate closely with founders, internal deal teams, and design resources to ensure alignment in messaging, structure, and visuals.
  • Apply insights from investor conversations and market trends to tailor narratives for specific capital partners.
  • Ensure materials meet the strategic objectives of each raise while adhering to Evvolve’s brand and communication standards.
  • Maintain strong quality control and consistency across deliverables, often managing several projects simultaneously.


What We’re Looking For

  • 1–3 years of experience in venture capital, private equity, investment banking, consulting, or a comparable analyst-level role.
  • Strong proficiency in presentation tools (PowerPoint required; Figma a strong plus).
  • Clear understanding of early-stage fundraising processes and startup growth dynamics.
  • Exceptional written communication skills with the ability to synthesize complex ideas into compelling content.
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and capable of managing multiple workflows in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative mindset and strong sense of ownership over deliverables.


Why Join Us

  • Join a mission-driven team shaping the future of venture capital and innovation.
  • Work with a global network of top-tier investors and high-impact founders.
  • Gain exposure to diverse sectors—from AI to sustainability to frontier technologies.
  • Play a critical role in the capital-raising process for fast-growing ventures.
  • Enjoy a flexible work environment with opportunities for global travel and cross-office collaboration.

  • Definir a estratégia técnica do projeto, desenvolver e comunicando uma visão clara e estratégica para a aplicação de Inteligência Artificial, Visão Computacional e Data Science na Instituição;
  • Orientar desenvolvimento de Modelos Avançados, supervisionando a equipe na criação de modelos estatísticos e de aprendizado de máquina utilizando técnicas avançadas e modernas;
  • Aplicar e conceber arquitetura de soluções inovadoras para plataformas Network as a Service (NaaS) com foco em integração de técnicas de IA e ML;
  • Realizar estudos aprofundados e análises de estruturas, dados, plataformas e ferramentas de IA/ML, fornecendo insights valiosos para tomada de decisões;
  • Preparar documentações estratégica e técnica abrangente sobre as soluções propostas e adotadas, garantindo a compreensão e rastreabilidade dos projetos;
  • Liderar o Time de QA, provendo orientação e suporte ao time de Garantia da Qualidade para garantir a confiabilidade e robustez das soluções implementadas;
  • Executar revisão técnica proativa, examinar o código desenvolvido e assegurar que ele esteja em conformidade com as melhores práticas da tecnologia e promovendo a melhoria contínua;

Requisitos e qualificações


Ensino Superior Completo na área de tecnologia, preferencialmente em Engenharia de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou Ciência da Computação;


Experiência em:

  • Linguagem de programação Python ou Go,
  • Métodos estatísticos para análise de dados,
  • Desenvolvimento de algoritmos de Machine Learning/Deep Learning,
  • Arquitetura em microserviços,
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações web modernas,
  • Banco de dados de alto volume (relacional, não relacional, data lake ou data warehouse);


Conhecimentos em:

  • Conhecimento em Keras, PyTorch e TensorFlow,
  • MLOps,
  • Plataformas Cloud (AWS ou Azure),
  • CI/CD,
  • Melhores práticas de desenvolvimento,
  • Metodologias ágeis.

  • Prática em projetos com equipes multidisciplinares;

title: Data Analyst
description:
Since 1995, Red Oak Technologies has been a trusted partner in the tech industry, delivering innovative talent solutions that drive progress. We specialize in quickly acquiring and efficiently matching top-tier professional talent with clients in immediate need of highly skilled contract, permanent or project management based resources.


Data Analyst, Sales Finance


Location: LATAM- BRAZIL OR MEXICO

Hours: 40 hours per week

Duration: 1 year contract


About the Role and Team

Our Client is seeking a Data Analyst (Contractor) to support the Sales Finance team. This role will help accelerate analysis, reporting, and business insights by partnering closely with the Senior Manager of Sales Finance Analytics. You will work on a mix of ad hoc analysis, deep dive projects, dashboard and BI development, and light data engineering in support of Finance, Sales, Marketing, and Product teams.


This is a hands-on execution role focused on delivering high quality analytical work that helps the company move faster. The ideal candidate has moderate SQL skills, strong business acumen, and the ability to learn quickly in a dynamic environment.


Projects and Initiatives You Will Support

  • Run ad hoc analysis to answer business questions related to customer behavior, product usage, sales performance, and financial trends
  • Support deep dive projects such as weighted pipeline evaluation, consumption reporting, sales attainment analysis, and LTV to CAC modeling
  • Build and maintain draft BI dashboards in Tableau or similar tools
  • Write SQL queries to pull, clean, and transform data in Snowflake
  • Support the development of repeatable data models for financial and operational metrics
  • Draft summaries and written analysis that highlight insights and trends
  • Partner with internal teams to clarify metric definitions and ensure consistency across reporting
  • Document logic, definitions, and assumptions to support long term reuse
  • You Will Be a Great Addition to the Team If You Have


Minimum Qualifications:


  • 1 to 3 years of experience in data analytics, BI, or a related field
  • Moderate SQL experience with a willingness to learn and improve
  • Familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI
  • Strong analytical reasoning and the ability to connect data to business concepts
  • Clear written communication skills and the ability to summarize findings
  • Comfortable working independently and managing priorities in an async environment
  • High attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem solving


Extra skills that stand out:


  • A builder mentality with interest in creating small tools or solutions to improve workflows. Curiosity and experimentation with AI tools is a plus.
  • Experience working with SaaS metrics such as ARR, NRR, churn, pipeline, product usage, or LTV to CAC
  • Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouses
  • Experience supporting finance, revenue, or business operations teams
  • Knowledge of Python or scripting for data automation is helpful but not required
  • Familiarity with data modeling or ELT concepts
  • Contract Structure



Red Oak Technologies is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. See what it’s like to be at the top; connect with one of our recruiters and apply today.

title: Lead WordPress Developer
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!


About Olly Olly

Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.


The Role

We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.


You'll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You'll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.


Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data


HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy


Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges


Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed


Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles


Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members


Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments


What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members' skills and create succession planning


Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You'll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.


Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits package. This is a full-time remote position, though you'll be working closely with team members across time zones.


Our Culture

We value directness, authenticity, and results over politics or polish. We're building something meaningful for small business owners who are often underserved by the marketing industry. We expect excellence but also recognize that real growth happens when people are supported, challenged, and given autonomy to do their best work.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Who are we?


Fulcrum Digital is an agile and next-generation digital accelerating company providing digital transformation and technology services right from ideation to implementation.

These services have applicability across a variety of industries including banking & financial services, insurance, retail, higher education, food, healthcare, and manufacturing. Headquartered in the bustling city of New Jersey, Fulcrum was rated among the fastest growing Software Companies in Inc 5000 Club and No. 7 Technology firm in New Jersey by NJ Biz.

Our team of business and technical consultants is spread across the US and other regions including the UK, Portugal, LATAM, Australia, and Finland where we have our operations.


The Role


We look for you to bring initiative and resourcefulness while you balance vital responsibilities. In this role, your primary mission will be to provide best-in-class executive support which involves a wide variety of duties that are critical to ensuring smooth and seamless business processes.


What you’ll do?


  • Heavy calendar management - owns and coordinates a heavy, complex meeting schedule that often includes international participants. Includes the management of calendars, related correspondence, meeting details, logistics coordination.
  • Events - Coordinates events and executive meetings, from recurring staff meetings to Town Hall meetings. Provides project management, budget management, space requirements, IT coordination, and all other support required for these various events and meetings.
  • Board Preparation - Prepares and manages communication, materials, and meeting preparation for the Board of Directors with perfect execution.
  • PowerPoint and Word Documents - Prepares electronic files with validated ability to proofread for spelling and grammar.
  • Office support activities.
  • Travel coordination- Leads and coordinates travel itineraries and related meetings, which are sometimes international. Includes the coordination of calendars, travel plans, expense reimbursements, filing, etc.
  • Other administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Requirements


  • Ability to handle highly sensitive business and human resources communications, data and other information with confidentiality and discretion.
  • Ability to establish relationships of strong communication and network within the administrative team. We will need to work cross-functionally regarding issues of travel, meeting schedules, and material completion.
  • Utilize knowledge of company operations, policies, and department functions to proactively perform assigned duties and with minimal direct supervision.
  • Resiliency; able to diplomatically and constructively, but firmly, ensure objectives are met.
  • Appropriate professional presentation. You should be able to communicate effectively with C-level executives, Board members, and other high-level clients and candidates, and line-level employees, with equal dexterity, respect, and composure. Also, be able to present oneself as a representative of the Manager's office, and, to a very large and diverse internal and external audience.
  • Ability to speak clearly and succinctly relative to needs, questions, goals, etc. Must be direct in asking for clarification, guidance, opinions, etc. of the executive to ensure accurate delivery on commitments, scheduling needs, meeting set-up, etc.
  • Able to act independently, operating on accurate details and excellent judgment.
  • Able to identify and leverage other resources within the business to clarify needs, delegate tasks, etc. in order to keep a very busy desk operating smoothly and efficiently.
  • A ‘can-do’ perspective is imperative, and the ability to simply ‘get-things-done’ under ambiguous, time-constrained, high-pressure circumstances routinely.
  • Able to quickly gain an understanding of the executive’s style and adapt own style and presentation to that of the executives. Effective interpersonal skills to be capable of working with all levels of office personnel.
  • Advanced proficiency in MS Office

title: Líder Técnico III (Web/Mobile/Servidores)
description:
O Inatel está recrutando Especialista para atuar na liderança técnica de projetos de software, no ICC PDI SW.

  • Liderar tecnicamente projetos de desenvolvimento de software; propondo soluções que atendam ao negócio e sejam performáticas e flexíveis, considerando requisitos de escalabilidade, confiabilidade e desempenho das soluções integradas;

  • Vivência na gestão de projetos ligados a tecnologias Mobile
  • Experiência em práticas de DevOps, incluindo Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD e monitoramento;
  • Proficiência em desenvolvimento de soluções Web, aplicações móveis e soluções em nuvem;
  • Domínio em banco de dados não relacional/relacional, Webservices, Design patterns, Modelagem de projetos, Ferramentas de análise de código e de controle de versionamento de código;
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis, especialmente Scrum, e ferramentas de gestão de projetos como JIRA;
  • Conhecimentos em testes automatizados e unitários e ferramentas de design UX/UI.



Informações adicionais

Horário de trabalho: Segunda a sexta, das 8h as 12h e das 13h30 as 17h30.


Local de trabalho : As atividades poderão ser realizadas em regime de Teletrabalho "Home Office".

title: Backend Developer
description:
The professional will work primarily in the Conversion Squad, responsible for lead acquisition flows and marketing forms — a high‑impact and business‑critical area at Creditas.

The main focus will be Back-end development using Kotlin + Spring Boot.


The developer may also support small tasks in Front-end/BFF applications built with Next.js and Node.js, collaborating closely with product and engineering teams.


Responsibilities


  • Develop Back-end solutions ensuring functionality, maintainability, performance, and adherence to engineering best practices.
  • Build services aligned with business strategy, OKRs, and product initiatives.
  • Implement and maintain reliable and scalable microservices and REST APIs.
  • Create automated tests following the testing pyramid.
  • Work in a collaborative environment with pair programming and a strong feedback culture.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively in daily meetings, agile ceremonies, and when raising blockers.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement within the Conversion Squad projects.



Competencies


  • Strong and active communication — especially during daily meetings.
  • Proactive attitude in raising issues, proposing solutions, and seeking support when needed.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (product, design, engineering).
  • Organization and strong sense of ownership over deliverables.
  • Hard Skills — Mandatory (Must Have):
  • Proficiency in Kotlin and Spring Boot (top priority).
  • Solid experience with microservices and REST API architecture.
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases.
  • Experience with automated testing and understanding of the testing pyramid.
  • Experience with at least one other Back-end language: Java, Python, Ruby, Go (Kotlin is mandatory).
  • Familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).


Nice to Have:


  • Experience with modern Front-end frameworks (React, Next.js, Angular, Vue.js).
  • Knowledge of BFF using Node.js.
  • Experience with messaging tools (Kafka, AWS SQS, etc.).
  • Knowledge of Clean Code and Design Patterns.


Skill Set


  • Kotlin + Spring Boot
  • Microservices & Distributed Architecture
  • REST APIs
  • Relational Databases
  • Automated Testing

title: Senior Gen AI Engineer (Copilot)
description:
Senior Generative AI Engineer – Copilot / Power AutomateSummary


We are seeking a Senior Generative AI Engineer with hands-on experience in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Automate to support and scale our organization’s use of AI-driven productivity tools. This role blends technical expertise in building and optimizing agents with the ability to support and guide non-technical users. The engineer will troubleshoot Copilot issues, review and refine agents, and ensure compliance with data loss prevention (DLP) and governance policies. Beyond day-to-day support, they’ll help strengthen our Power Platform Center of Excellence (COE) through documentation, lifecycle standards, and observability practices.


Key Responsibilities


  • Support & Troubleshooting: Own Copilot and Power Automate issue resolution, including connectors, permissions, and workflow errors.
  • Agent Review & Optimization: Refine agents for efficiency, scalability, and compliance with governance standards.
  • User Enablement: Guide employees in safely building and optimizing agents, explaining platform limits and data-handling best practices.
  • Architecture Awareness: Apply knowledge of agent architectures, prompt lifecycles, and RAG patterns to improve design quality.
  • Governance & COE: Partner with data, security, and compliance teams on DLP alignment and contribute to Power Platform COE monitoring and lifecycle initiatives.
  • Documentation & Improvement: Create user guides, document patterns, and propose enhancements based on recurring issues.


Required Skills


  • Proven experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Automate (core ).
  • Ability to design, troubleshoot, and optimize agent workflows and connectors.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 ecosystem , DLP policies, and governance controls.
  • Strong understanding of agent architectures and prompt-response lifecycles.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to translate technical details for non-technical users.


Preferred Skills


  • Knowledge of RAG, multi-agent orchestration, or MCP server concepts.
  • Experience with observability, or cost monitoring.
  • Exposure to enterprise data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Dataverse, Azure Data Lake).
  • Contribution to a Power Platform COE or similar governance effort.


We Offer:


  • 100% remote job.
  • Long term job.
  • Carreer path.

title: Chef Tournant
description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
  • Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
  • Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.
  • Must be proficient in completing tasks, work efficiently and productively.
  • Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
  • Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
  • Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
  • Responsible for follow-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
  • Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.
  • Prepare daily electronic food requisitions needed for his section production and countercheck deliveries for its accuracy; Report any discrepancies to his immediate supervisor.
  • Must be able to oversee any main section (Sauce, Entremetier, Fish, Roast, Outlet CDP, Tournant and Cold Kitchen) and its entire food production.
  • Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within his section.
  • Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
  • Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food & Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
  • Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor’s instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company’s rules and regulations.


QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION

  • A minimum of 5 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef Tournant (shipboard experience preferred).
  • A culinary school degree is required.
  • Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Who are we?


Fulcrum Digital is an agile and next-generation digital accelerating company providing digital transformation and technology services right from ideation to implementation.

These services have applicability across a variety of industries including banking & financial services, insurance, retail, higher education, food, healthcare, and manufacturing. Headquartered in the bustling city of New Jersey, Fulcrum was rated among the fastest growing Software Companies in Inc 5000 Club and No. 7 Technology firm in New Jersey by NJ Biz.

Our team of business and technical consultants is spread across the US and other regions including the UK, Portugal, LATAM, Australia, and Finland where we have our operations.


The Role


We look for you to bring initiative and resourcefulness while you balance vital responsibilities. In this role, your primary mission will be to provide best-in-class executive support which involves a wide variety of duties that are critical to ensuring smooth and seamless business processes.


What you’ll do?


  • Heavy calendar management - owns and coordinates a heavy, complex meeting schedule that often includes international participants. Includes the management of calendars, related correspondence, meeting details, logistics coordination.
  • Events - Coordinates events and executive meetings, from recurring staff meetings to Town Hall meetings. Provides project management, budget management, space requirements, IT coordination, and all other support required for these various events and meetings.
  • Board Preparation - Prepares and manages communication, materials, and meeting preparation for the Board of Directors with perfect execution.
  • PowerPoint and Word Documents - Prepares electronic files with validated ability to proofread for spelling and grammar.
  • Office support activities.
  • Travel coordination- Leads and coordinates travel itineraries and related meetings, which are sometimes international. Includes the coordination of calendars, travel plans, expense reimbursements, filing, etc.
  • Other administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Requirements


  • Ability to handle highly sensitive business and human resources communications, data and other information with confidentiality and discretion.
  • Ability to establish relationships of strong communication and network within the administrative team. We will need to work cross-functionally regarding issues of travel, meeting schedules, and material completion.
  • Utilize knowledge of company operations, policies, and department functions to proactively perform assigned duties and with minimal direct supervision.
  • Resiliency; able to diplomatically and constructively, but firmly, ensure objectives are met.
  • Appropriate professional presentation. You should be able to communicate effectively with C-level executives, Board members, and other high-level clients and candidates, and line-level employees, with equal dexterity, respect, and composure. Also, be able to present oneself as a representative of the Manager's office, and, to a very large and diverse internal and external audience.
  • Ability to speak clearly and succinctly relative to needs, questions, goals, etc. Must be direct in asking for clarification, guidance, opinions, etc. of the executive to ensure accurate delivery on commitments, scheduling needs, meeting set-up, etc.
  • Able to act independently, operating on accurate details and excellent judgment.
  • Able to identify and leverage other resources within the business to clarify needs, delegate tasks, etc. in order to keep a very busy desk operating smoothly and efficiently.
  • A ‘can-do’ perspective is imperative, and the ability to simply ‘get-things-done’ under ambiguous, time-constrained, high-pressure circumstances routinely.
  • Able to quickly gain an understanding of the executive’s style and adapt own style and presentation to that of the executives. Effective interpersonal skills to be capable of working with all levels of office personnel.
  • Advanced proficiency in MS Office

title: Shopify Developer CRO
description:
Shopify CRO Developer

Location: Remote

Compensation: USD $1,800–$2,500/month

Working Hours: 6 AM – 2 PM EST or at least 6 hours overlap within this window


Overview

We’re looking for a senior, hands-on Shopify expert to rebuild, optimize, and maintain a high-volume DTC storefront. Your work will directly impact conversion (goal: 0.85% → 1.6%+ in 90 days ) and you’ll collaborate with our CRO strategist, growth, and ops teams.

This is a technical execution role — not strategy only.


Core Responsibilities

1. Front-End Shopify Development

  • Rebuild key templates (Home, Collection, PDP, Cart, Checkout) with a mobile-first, conversion-focused approach.
  • Implement CRO/UI enhancements: trust signals, sticky ATC, bundles, urgency, reviews, upsells, cart optimization.
  • Replace heavy apps with custom code when possible to increase performance + reduce cost.

2. Speed & Performance Optimization

  • Bring load speeds under 2.5 seconds across top pages.
  • Remove theme bloat: unused scripts, oversized media, duplicate app calls.
  • Implement:
  • Code splitting
  • Minification + compression
  • Defer/async scripts
  • Lazy loading
  • Image optimization via Shopify CDN
  • Maintain a clean, version-controlled deployment workflow.

3. Conversion & Funnel Optimization

  • Diagnose and fix checkout drop-offs + friction points (Shop Pay, PayPal, Prime, etc.).
  • Improve ATC rate, product discovery, clarity, and mobile usability.
  • Implement A/B testing variants from the CRO team or propose your own.

4. Tracking, Instrumentation & Analytics

  • Configure and maintain GA4 event tracking (ATC, IC, upsells, search behavior, scroll depth, etc.).
  • Set up session recording and heatmaps (Hotjar or Clarity).
  • Interpret funnels with the team and provide actionable recommendations.

5. Reporting & Communication

  • Weekly updates on:
  • Conversion rate trends
  • AOV impacts
  • Funnel drop-off changes
  • Site issues or speed regressions
  • Maintain clear documentation and async communication with product, ops, and design.


✅ Requirements

  • 3+ years building custom Shopify themes (Liquid, JSON, JS, CSS, Shopify APIs).
  • Proven results improving mobile conversion and checkout/speed performance .
  • Hands-on experience with Dawn/OS 2.0 custom theme development .
  • Strong frontend fundamentals: modular Liquid architecture, performance-first coding, clean components.
  • Deep Shopify optimization skills: theme speed improvements, app performance audits, and custom replacements for heavy apps.
  • Experience working with high-volume DTC brands .


✨ Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with CRO tools (Rebuy, Bundler, Zipify, Okendo, Stamped).
  • GA4 modeling, attribution & Shopify Pixel system.
  • Headless / Hydrogen experience.
  • Hotjar / Clarity usage for experience analysis.
  • Familiarity with Klaviyo event triggers.
  • Experience partnering with CRO strategists, designers, or A/B testing teams.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Since 1995, Red Oak Technologies has been a trusted partner in the tech industry, delivering innovative talent solutions that drive progress. We specialize in quickly acquiring and efficiently matching top-tier professional talent with clients in immediate need of highly skilled contract, permanent or project management based resources.


Data Analyst, Sales Finance


Location: LATAM- BRAZIL OR MEXICO

Hours: 40 hours per week

Duration: 1 year contract


About the Role and Team

Our Client is seeking a Data Analyst (Contractor) to support the Sales Finance team. This role will help accelerate analysis, reporting, and business insights by partnering closely with the Senior Manager of Sales Finance Analytics. You will work on a mix of ad hoc analysis, deep dive projects, dashboard and BI development, and light data engineering in support of Finance, Sales, Marketing, and Product teams.


This is a hands-on execution role focused on delivering high quality analytical work that helps the company move faster. The ideal candidate has moderate SQL skills, strong business acumen, and the ability to learn quickly in a dynamic environment.


Projects and Initiatives You Will Support

  • Run ad hoc analysis to answer business questions related to customer behavior, product usage, sales performance, and financial trends

  • Document logic, definitions, and assumptions to support long term reuse

Minimum Qualifications:


  • 1 to 3 years of experience in data analytics, BI, or a related field

  • Familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI
  • Strong analytical reasoning and the ability to connect data to business concepts
  • Clear written communication skills and the ability to summarize findings
  • Comfortable working independently and managing priorities in an async environment
  • High attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem solving


Extra skills that stand out:


  • A builder mentality with interest in creating small tools or solutions to improve workflows. Curiosity and experimentation with AI tools is a plus.
  • Experience working with SaaS metrics such as ARR, NRR, churn, pipeline, product usage, or LTV to CAC

title: Software Engineer (Murex)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Murex Developer to join our team, supporting strategic initiatives within the financial sector. The role begins as fully remote , with the expectation of relocation to Portugal after an agreed transition period. You will work closely with multicultural teams, contributing to the enhancement and stability of the Murex MX.3 platform.


Responsibilities

  • Develop, customize, and maintain components and configurations within Murex MX.3 , across modules such as Trading, Risk, Collateral, and Back Office.
  • Build and enhance workflows, simulation views, formulas, and MxML Exchange interfaces.
  • Design and maintain integrations with internal and external systems (REST, SOAP, MQ, APIs, ETL, etc.).
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents, ensuring system stability and performance.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, QA, and project teams to gather requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Support release cycles, functional testing, regression testing, and UAT phases.
  • Maintain compliance with technical standards, documentation, and governance processes.


Required Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Murex MX.3 (configuration, development, or integration).
  • Solid knowledge of Datamart, MxML Exchange, Workflows, Simulation Views , and other core Murex components.
  • Strong programming skills: Java, SQL, Shell Script , and ideally Python.
  • Experience with system integrations, middleware, or messaging platforms.
  • Good understanding of financial instruments, especially derivatives (FX, IRD, Fixed Income, Equities, Commodities).
  • Strong English communication skills.
  • Willingness and eligibility to relocate to Portugal after the initial remote period.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience working with major banks or large international financial institutions.
  • Knowledge of DevOps methodologies and tools (CI/CD, Git, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum .
  • Murex certifications or experience with MX.2 → MX.3 migrations.

Desired Profile

  • Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving ability.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in remote and multicultural environments.
  • Proactive, organized, detail-oriented, and capable of working under pressure.
  • Motivated to engage in a long-term role involving relocation.

What We Offer

  • Remote work during the initial phase.
  • Support and guidance for future relocation to Portugal .
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Opportunity to work on complex, high-impact financial systems.
  • Multicultural work environment and professional growth opportunities.
